title: WI4: edglex.com citation/format audit + link-rot snapshot backfill
body:
## Summary

WI4 of the Blog Accuracy & Link-Rot Resilience Program. Citation/format audit + 129 external-link snapshots across 39 legal blog posts. Precedes WI5 (legal-substance re-review — expert+founder gate).

## Changes

- `blog/_snapshots/` directory (new) — 129 JSON snapshot files
- `blog/_snapshots/WI4-AUDIT-REPORT.md` (new) — full audit findings

## Citation Audit Results

- **39/39 posts** have Sources & References section
- **0 fabricated citations** detected
- **7 non-whitelisted source domains** (all secondary legal commentary used alongside primary authority)
- **151 external links** extracted, **129 snapshots** created
- **101 live (200)**, 23 rate-limited (403 — law.cornell.edu), 3 dead (404), 2 URL errors

## Primary Source Distribution

| Source | Links | Whitelisted |
|---|---|---|
| law.cornell.edu | 54 | ✅ |
| irs.gov | 41 | ✅ |
| americanbar.org | 26 | ✅ |
| federalregister.gov | 9 | ✅ |
| Other gov (epa, osha, occ, cms, fdic, ftc, gao, nhtsa, uscourts) | 14 | ✅ |

## Validation

- `check_blog_link_archival.py --site edglex.com` → PASS

## Out of Scope

- Legal-substance re-review (WI5 — expert+founder gate, Domain 23)
- Content corrections (follow-up per blog-corrections.md)
- dateModified metadata addition (follow-up)

title: fix(blog): add missing migrated images for 2 blog posts
body:
Two blog posts referenced images that weren't copied during the 2026-07-29 legal-site consolidation into edglex.com. The `check_website_integrity` validator caught the broken internal src links.

**Files added** (copied from original redirect-only sites):
- `blog/assets/loophole-finder-pipeline.png` + `.sha256` + `.meta.json` (from findmyloophole.com)
- `blog/assets/law-gaps-research-pipeline.png` + `.sha256` + `.meta.json` (from lawgaps.com)

**Validation:**
- `python3 tools/scripts/check_website_integrity.py` → PASS (0 findings across all 15 sites)

Tracking: 5W #143 (website validation rungs)

title: feat(blog): add Pagefind client-side search
body: Adds per-site Pagefind client-side search to the blog index. Static index committed under /pagefind/ (39 pages indexed). No backend, no external service. Search input themed to the site accent. Post list hides while results show.
